test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

Social media is ______ to market products.
solution:
The correct answer is **"used."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the passive voice, indicating that someone or something is doing the action of marketing products on social media.
 
• The phrase "used to" shows that a particular thing always happened or was true in the past, especially if it no longer happens or is no longer true.
 
 
• **Example**: *She **used to**__ live in Glasgow.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Social media is __**used**__ to market products.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"using"**, is the present participle form of the verb and is not appropriate in this context.
 
• Option 2, **"use"**, is the base form of the verb and is not appropriate in this context.
 
• Option 3,** "uses"**, is the third person singular present tense form of the verb and is not appropriate in this context.
